# Generated Code Template

Use this template for generated C# text when the repository has no stronger convention.

```csharp
string source = $$"""
    // <auto-generated/>
    #nullable enable

    namespace {{model.Namespace}};

    partial {{model.TypeKind}} {{model.TypeName}}{{model.TypeParameters}}
    {
        {{generatedMembers}}
    }
    """;
```

## Rules

- Start generated files with `// <auto-generated/>` so analyzers and reviewers recognize generated output.
- Include `#nullable enable` unless the project has a different explicit convention.
- Use fully qualified names for framework and package types when generated code may live in arbitrary user namespaces.
- Normalize line endings and sort generated members by a stable key.
- Make hint names unique by including enough namespace, containing type, member, or input-path information.
- For nested partial types, generate the full containing type chain. Preserve type kind, generic parameters, constraints, and namespace style.
- If generated files are persisted for review, keep each file focused on one target type or concern.
